description: A fictional heavy rivet driver pistol game prop for a builder, chunky low-poly, one hand, held level with the firing tube forward. One tall ochre painted head block with wide chamfers and a raised ochre step along its top. On the front of the head one thick flat octagonal dark steel nose plate with one fat round dark steel firing tube sticking out of its centre, a dark round opening in its tip. Closing the top rear of the head one big round charcoal air-cell cap, a fat two-tier octagonal cylinder lying along the axis and sticking out behind the head. Under the rear of the head one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with big diagonal ribs and one thick charcoal trigger. Under the nose one thick straight dark charcoal rivet magazine post running down to the grip base, with exactly four big round dark steel rivet heads in a row along its left side; one thick charcoal bar joins the magazine bottom to the grip base and one thick charcoal guard bar crosses from the magazine to the grip under the trigger, so the magazine, the bars and the grip frame two open windows. One small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on the left flank of the head.
proportions: About 0.34 m long, 0.09 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.78 : 1 : 3.33)
sides: on the LEFT flank only: the teal lamp window on the head and the four round rivet heads along the magazine post (domes standing a little proud of it). The right flank is plain: smooth ochre head, plain magazine side. The nose plate, the firing tube, the air-cell cap, the grip, the trigger, the magazine post and the two bars are on the centre line.
